articles.title: Crypto platform Gemini’s stock is down 80% from its IPO. That’s reviving takeover speculation
articles.snippet: The crypto platform’s market value has fallen to about $753 million, putting fresh attention on the licenses, custody infrastructure and customer relationships a buyer could inherit.

articles.title: Coinbase, Robinhood, Circle could be early winners of SEC's tokenized-stock push, analysts say
articles.snippet: Goldman Sachs and Citizens analysts said the agency's move create new opportunities in custody, tokenization infrastructure and stablecoin settlement, while giving brokers room to expand onchain products.

articles.title: Crypto traders braced for a total wipeout this week but Bitcoin had other plans
articles.snippet: Market experts view bitcoin’s price stability as evidence of its fundamental independence from Washington, maintaining that global liquidity and adoption cycles remain the primary growth drivers.

articles.title: Clarity Act, we hardly knew ye: We look at what was in the bill and what's replacing it
articles.snippet: U.S. agencies are racing to substitute their regulations for the law that was meant to set crypto markets in governmental bedrock, but will the stand-ins last?

articles.title: 'We have lost control': Crypto pioneer warns AI could trigger systemic banking and infrastructure shocks
articles.snippet: Marc van der Chijs sold much of his bitcoin to invest in AI. Now, growing concerns about the technology accompany a move to put some profits back into crypto.
